title: "project_id should not be empty" Error When Reauthorizing Contentstack Connection in Automate

extracted_facts.problem: Reauthorizing an existing Contentstack connected app in Automate (Agent OS) returns a "project_id should not be empty" HTTP 400 Bad Request error, preventing the customer from creating new automations using the Contentstack connector with workflow access.
extracted_facts.root_cause: The error occurs specifically during the reauthorization flow of an existing connected Contentstack app in Automate; it was not observed when setting up a new connection.
resolution_steps: Do not reauthorize the existing Contentstack connected app.
Create a new Contentstack connection instead, either from Settings → Connected Apps or by selecting "Add new account" within the automation step.
Grant the required permissions during the initial authorization of the new connection.
